chunks: And whatever was in it from Dāwūd ibn Isḥāq, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from his uncle Muḥammad ibn Abī al-Qāsim, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Dāwūd ibn Isḥāq.

key_terms.أَبِيهِ: from his father, part of the chain of narrators
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it or narrated it
key_terms.عَنْ عَمِّهِ: from his uncle, indicating a familial link in transmission

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Dāwūd ibn Isḥāq in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage provides the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Dāwūd ibn Isḥāq. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission in hadith literature, identifying the intermediaries through whom the narration was received.
